source.title: Astrological Opticks
source.author: Johannes Angelus (also attributed to Regiomontanus), translated by Robert Turner
source.transcription: Text Creation Partnership A84433 (Wing E737, EEBO-TCP phase 2) — a hand-keyed, proofread transcription of the 1655 English edition, CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication); fetched from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/textcreationpartnership/A84433/master/A84433.xml
source.note: Excerpts are lightly normalized (long s, a couple of printer's ligatures) but otherwise the 1655 translation's own wording — the one-degree image plus its one-line signification, in the order Aries 1-30 through Pisces 1-30 (degree-symbol:1 through degree-symbol:360, global index = floor(longitude)+1, matching #405's own convention). The source's own degree numbering has several typos and OCR artefacts (duplicate or skipped printed numbers, "Iu"/"It" for "In", a missing "the"); none of that affects which degree an excerpt is filed under here — each sign's 30 degree-images were counted and ordered by position in the chapter, after discarding the chapter's own 2-3 decan ("face") intro paragraphs, not by trusting the printed label. No degree in this edition is missing text; every one of the 360 keys below has a real excerpt, not an invented one. degree-symbol:360's trailing chapter-transition sentence ("Here followeth the nature and signification of the Planets...", the next chapter's own header, run on in the source transcription with no paragraph break) was trimmed — it is not part of this degree's image/signification, same reasoning as discarding the decan intro paragraphs above.

excerpts.degree-symbol:1: In the First degree of ♈, there ascendeth a man holding a Sicle in in his righ hand, and in his left hand an Engyne of Warre. A man then borne, or querent, shall be laboirous, and much exercised in Warlike affaires.
excerpts.degree-symbol:2: In the Second degree of ♈, there ascendeth a man having a Head like a Dog, stretching out his right hand towards the Skies, and holding a Staffe in his left hand. It denotes the man borne under that degree, will be a Litigious and troublesome person and envious as a dog.
excerpts.degree-symbol:3: The Third degree of ♈ ariseth like a handsome man, stretching forth his right hand as if he were shewing the various things of the world, and applying his left hand to a girdle bound about him. It signifies a peaceable quiet person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:4: In the Fourth degree of ♈, there ascendeth a man with a curled head of haire, holding a Hawk in his right hand, and a whip in his left hand. The person signified by this ascention, is seldom rich; but a spender of his estate, consuming all he hath in his age.
excerpts.degree-symbol:5: The First degree of Aries ascendeth like two men, one holding in his hand an Axe, cleaving wood; the other, holding a Scepter in his righthand. It signifies a person that will be a provident house-keeper; and a provider for his family.
excerpts.degree-symbol:6: In the sixth degree of ♈, there ascends a King Crowned, holding a Globe in his right hand, and a Scepter in his left. The native under this Ascention, will exceed all his kindred and acquaintance in greatnesse.
excerpts.degree-symbol:7: The Seventh degree of Aries ascendeth like a man Armed all over, holding a dart in his right hand. It denotes a wary carefull person, a preserver of himself.
excerpts.degree-symbol:8: In the eighth degree of Aries, there ascends a man having his head covered with a Helmet, and no where else Armed, holding in his right hand a Crosse-bow. Under this degree are signified quarrelsome contentious persons, and Murderers.
excerpts.degree-symbol:9: In the Ninth degree of Aries there ascendeth a man bare-headed, well clothed over his body with a Gowne, holding a sword in his left hand, with the point downwards. It signifies talkative persons full of words, and of a wonderfull Spirit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:10: The Tenth degree of Aries ariseth like a man bare-headed, but clothed over his body, pearcing a Beare thorow, with a speare. It signifies a Forrester or Hunter.
excerpts.degree-symbol:11: In the Eleventh degree of Aries, there ascendeth a woman, standing holding a Distaffe in her right hand. It signifies Persons loving freind-ship and hospitality.
excerpts.degree-symbol:12: In the Twelfth degree of Aries there ascendeth an Eagle, spreading out her wings over her young-ones, sitting under her. It denotes ambitious persons, Proud, Covetuous of applause, and aspiring to be exalted to dignity.
excerpts.degree-symbol:13: The Thirteenth degree of Aries ascendeth like a subtil person with his right hand, holding a Goate by the horns. The Person borne under him, will be wonderfull famous.
excerpts.degree-symbol:14: The 14. Degree of Aries ariseth like a Captived man standing upright between two pillars having his Armes bound with two Chains. It denotes persons much Subject to Imprisonment.
excerpts.degree-symbol:15: The 15. Degree of Aries ascendeth like a man bare-headed, his armes stretched out, and cloathed with an Habergeon: it Signifies theeves, retchlesse, leud, and wicked persons.
excerpts.degree-symbol:16: In the 16. Degree, of Aries ariseth a man labouring with a dungfork; or sometimes a man powring water out of a pitcher. it denotes a Fisher-man or a Labourer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:17: The 17. Degree ariseth like a man standing Idle, Clothed in fine silke. It Represents fine delicate persons.
excerpts.degree-symbol:18: In the 18. Degree, ascends a woman sitting on a Chair, holding up her right hand: it denotes a man Loving peace and quietnesse.
excerpts.degree-symbol:19: In the 19. Degree of Aries, ascends a man cloath'd with an Habergeon standing & shewing treasure and money with his hands. A Theefe, Wicked, debauched person, is signified by this Degree.
excerpts.degree-symbol:20: In the 20. Degree of Aries, ascendeth a man with a Helmet on his head, and an Ostrith-Feather in his Hat; Riding upon a Bull, Leading a horse in his Left-hand. The man born under this Degree, will be malicious.
excerpts.degree-symbol:21: The 21. Degree of Aries ascendeth a dog sitting and turning his face towards a Lyon. It Signifies a faithfull Companion.
excerpts.degree-symbol:22: In the 22. Degree of Aries, ariseth a Bear, sitting and holding a great Beame in his mouth. The man will be a wicked person that is signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:23: In the 23. Degree of Aries, there ascendeth 6. Serpents, three of them fighting against the other three. The man, then born, will have many enemies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:24: In the 24. Degree there ascendeth a naked woman, Covering her secrets with her left-hand, and holding up her right-hand. If the native be a woman, shee will be desirous of a man; If a man, much given to women.
excerpts.degree-symbol:25: In the 25. Degree of Aries, ariseth a man with Curled locks, Riding upon a Ram, holding him by the horns. It Signifies a Citizen covetous to beare rule.
excerpts.degree-symbol:26: The 26. Degree ariseth 2. Suns, one shining against the other. A man bearing rule and keeping his power, is Signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:27: The 27. Degree ascendeth like a great Dragon, lying upon the earth. A man that will be potent in his old age is Signified by this ascension.
excerpts.degree-symbol:28: In the 28. degree of Aries ascendeth a woman standing upright, being well clothed. It signifies a pleasant peaceable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:29: In the 29. degree ariseth a Man holding a Saw in his hands. A laborious person nourishing himself and his Wife by his labour, is signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:30: In the 30. degree of ♈, ascendeth an Austere Woman, leading a sadled horse in her right hand. The native under this degree, will be high-minded, ambitious to beare rule over others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:31: In the First degree of ♉, ascendeth a man leading a Bull to the slaughter, holding a Staffe in his hand. It signifies a Hangman.
excerpts.degree-symbol:32: In the Second degree of ♉ ariseth a woman holding a horse-tayle in her hand. It denotes an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:33: In the Third degree ascendeth an old Woman naked covering her pudenda with her left hand. It signifies a Woman desirous of a man in her old age, and to continue young.
excerpts.degree-symbol:34: In the Fourth, a Woman holding a whip in her right hand. In denotes a hasty angry person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:35: In the Fifth degree of ♉, ariseth a Bull sitting in a Chaldron. By this ascention are signified men loving hospitality, good house-keepers.
excerpts.degree-symbol:36: In the sixth degree ascends a man having three heads, and pointing to the ground with his right hand. It signifies a prudent wise and illustrious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:37: In the Seventh degree, arises a beautifull woman standing naked. It denores a man of a proud mind.
excerpts.degree-symbol:38: In the Eighth degree of ♉, ascends a sorrowfull Woman sitting upon a footstoole. It fignifies a man of a low humble dejected Spirit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:39: In the 9. degree of ♉, ariseth a man holding a whip in his hand feeding Sheep and Goats in a field. The man then borne will be a Neat-herd or Shephard.
excerpts.degree-symbol:40: In the 10 degree of ♉, ascendeth two men standing, with a Dog playing between them. It signifies an idle person, much addicted to venereous acts.
excerpts.degree-symbol:41: In the 11. degree, ariseth a Crow standing on the ground. It demonstrates a covetuous person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:42: In the 12. degree, arise, two women standing hand in hand. It imports a benevolent well minded man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:43: In the 13. degree of ♉, scends two Women with Staves, smiting and striking one another. It denotes a troublesome, contentions, wrangling person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:44: In the 14. degree ariseth a man holding a Staffe in his hand: hereby is signified an appeaser of quarels, or one restraining and bridling the contentious.
excerpts.degree-symbol:45: In the 15. degree, ascend 7. fowls, flying in the Aire. It Signifies an instable wavering minded man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:46: In the 16. degree, ascends a man riding on an Asse. It denotes a Sluggard, a man slow and tedious in all his actions.
excerpts.degree-symbol:47: In the 17. degreeof ♉, ariseth a Bull bound by the middle to a tree. It signifies a man much over-laden with daily labour.
excerpts.degree-symbol:48: In the 18. degree ascends two Bulls fighting one against another. It denotes a raging furious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:49: In the 19. degree, ascends a Woman powring water out of one pot into another. It signifies a smooth tongued person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:50: In the 20. degree of ♉, ascends two Dogs, a fighting. It demonstrates an envious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:51: In the 21. degree, there ariseth a Beare looking backwards. In signifies a wicked, malitious, and wrathfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:52: In the 22. degree, ascend three men holding one another by the hands: the person signified hereby, will be a lover of peace and friend-ship.
excerpts.degree-symbol:53: In the 23. degree ascends a man falling backwards to the earth. It signifies, a man unfortunate in all things.
excerpts.degree-symbol:54: In the 24. degree of ♉, ascends a crooked man holding himself up upon his staffe. It denotes a person weak and feeble in his Actions.
excerpts.degree-symbol:55: In the 25. degree, a man standing upright, and holding a Staffe in his hand. It signifies a valiant man, strong and powerfull in his deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:56: In the 26. degree, a man standing shewing his hand. A peaceable person, or a peace-maker is hereby signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:57: In the 27. degree, there ariseth the similitude of a field of wheate or Corne standing un-cut. This ascention denotes a gatherer together, and heaper up of riches.
excerpts.degree-symbol:58: In the 28. degree, a Woman leading a horse by the bridle. It denotes a person desirous to rule over others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:59: In the 29. degree, there ascendeth a Woman leading an Asse with a Bridle, or otherwise a Woman leading a he-Goate by the Horns. Hereby is signified a Woman that rules over her Husband.
excerpts.degree-symbol:60: In the 30. degree of ♉, there ascends a faire beautifull building. Hereby is signified a person delighting to do pleasant and delectable deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:61: In the 1. degree of ♊, ascendeth two men sitting on the ground holding one another by the hands. It signifies a joyfull merry man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:62: In the 2. degree of ♊, there ascends one man girt with a sword, leading two other naked men bound. The person hereby signifyed, will be a Jaylor, or Theefe-taker.
excerpts.degree-symbol:63: In the 3. degree, ariseth a man singing and playing on a Lute. It denotes a man, causing joy to others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:64: In the 4. degree, ascends a man leading his Wife by the hand. It signifies, one keeping good hospitality and entertainment for others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:65: It the 5. Degree a man holding a Crossebow in his left hand, and a girdle in his right. It signifies a man preparing for war.
excerpts.degree-symbol:66: In the 6. a man holding a ballance in his right-hand. It signifies a Marchant.
excerpts.degree-symbol:67: In the 7. two brides, hand in hand. It denores a person, imployed in nuptiall affairs.
excerpts.degree-symbol:68: In the 8. Degree, ascends a Smith Smiteing on Iron, and a woman standing by Idle. It Signifies a person shunning labour, and loving Idlenesse.
excerpts.degree-symbol:69: In the 9. Degree of ♊ ascends a king fitting on a throne, having a Globe in his right-hand and a Scepter in his left. Signifing a man shall have great power and Authority, that is born under this degree.
excerpts.degree-symbol:70: In the 10. Degree, a man ascends lifting up another man from the ground. It Signifies a person composing differences, freindlily, a mongst others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:71: In the 11. an Eagle fluttering with her wings over three of her young ones. The man will be a South-sayer, or Conjurer that is Signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:72: In the 12. Degree, arise two women standing weeping. It Signifies a Sorrowfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:73: In the 13. three Crownes standing together on the ground. It denotes a Covetous and Envious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:74: In the 14. ascends two Foxes devouring Henns. The man born under this degree, will be a glutton and Covetous.
excerpts.degree-symbol:75: In the 15. ascends a man having three heads. It Signifies one of good understanding.
excerpts.degree-symbol:76: The 16. ascends like a Bridge beside the water. It Signifies a man labouring without profit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:77: In the 17. Degree of ♊, ascends a man without hands, and Idle. It Signifies an unprofitable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:78: In the 18. degree, a Fox running Swiftly. It denotes a Laborious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:79: In the 19. Degree ascends a poor man carrying a Staffe on his shoulder. It Signifies the man will be a travailer, a foot-post.
excerpts.degree-symbol:80: In the 20. Degree, three Snakes lying on the ground The man born under this degree, will be wise and of good understanding.
excerpts.degree-symbol:81: In the 21. Degree, ascends a man sitting on Horse Back. It signifies a Clyent or one retayning to another to have his Defence
excerpts.degree-symbol:82: In the 22. ascend two Birds Chattering together. It Signifies a fowler.
excerpts.degree-symbol:83: In the 23. Degree a decrepit old man leaning on a staffe. It demon Strates a poor miserable Idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:84: In the 24. two women sitting at play together. It represents one given to mirth.
excerpts.degree-symbol:85: In the 25. Degree, a man holding a book open in his hand. It denotes a studious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:86: In the 26. of ♊, ascend two Doge fighting. it represents a quarelsome litigious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:87: In the 27. Degree, a woman ascends standing idle and weeping. An idle vagabond is hereby signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:88: In the 28. Degree, ascend two Bulls due greater then other. A Laborious man is hereby represented.
excerpts.degree-symbol:89: In the 29. Degree, ascend 3. Doggs, 2. running one way together, and the other the contrary way. The man thereby Signified will be a Huntsman to some Noble Man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:90: In the 30. Degree, ascend 2. men, each of them leading a Hound in a Chain. It Signifies a Huntsman of a Prince.
excerpts.degree-symbol:91: In the first degree of ♋, ascendeth a man and a woman holding one another by the hands and rejoycing. It signifies an Amiable person given to mirth.
excerpts.degree-symbol:92: In the Second Degree, ascends 2. women standing Idle, like 2. Turrets. The man signified hereby will be Idle.
excerpts.degree-symbol:93: In the Third Degree, arises two women Sitting, and tow men standing before them. It Signifies a serving man, one wayring upon anothers pleasure.
excerpts.degree-symbol:94: In the 4. a maide standing Idle, expecting a man. It represents a libidinous person full of lustfull thoughts.
excerpts.degree-symbol:95: In the 5. a woman standing expecting a man. It denotes a Luxurious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:96: In the 6. a man holding a Goat in a Brasse pot. It denotes a fool.
excerpts.degree-symbol:97: In the 7. a man leading a goate with a girdle about his horns. A Hangman is hereby Signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:98: In the 8. Degree of ♋, ascends a house, and a woman standing as it were absconding her self behind it. It Signifies a Lazy, slow, and lascivious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:99: In the 9. a woman holding a distaff in her right hand. It imports a laborious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:100: In the 10. a man holding a Chest in his right hand. It Signifies also a laborious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:101: In the 11. a ship standing in the water It represents a fisher-man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:102: In the 12. a man carrying the skin of a Beast on his shoulders. A Cobler or Currier, or such handicraft, is hereby signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:103: In the 13. a Boy sitting holding a Book open, with a pen in his hand. It represents a studious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:104: In the 14. a Lambe ascends having a Crown of Gold on his head. It Signifies a Gold Smith.
excerpts.degree-symbol:105: In the 15. ascends a horse and a mouse lying in her nest under the roofe thereof. It represents a man desirous to keep home.
excerpts.degree-symbol:106: In the 16. a bird holding a Serpent under her feet. It imports a man accounting himself Noble.
excerpts.degree-symbol:107: In the 17. Degree, a woman standing idle ascends. It Signifies a sluggish person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:108: In the 18. Degree of ♋ ascends 3. women sitting at play at Tables. A joyfull merry person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:109: In the 19. Degree, a man having a Spear in his right hand, and a pipe in his left. A stage player is hereby Signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:110: In the 20. a Dog sitting in a Chariot. It signifies a slothfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:111: In the 21. a Chariot standing empty. It denotes a person given to vanity.
excerpts.degree-symbol:112: In the 22. ascends a man standing idle. it signifies a slothfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:113: In the 23. ascends a running water. An instable unconstant person is Signified under this Degree.
excerpts.degree-symbol:114: In the 24. ascends 2. Horses, one leaping upon the others back. It represents a man of aspiring thoughts Coveting dignity and authority over others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:115: In the 25. a Horse running in a field. It Signifies an instable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:116: In the 26. Degree, a water Springing out of mountaines. It signifies a moveable unstable man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:117: In the 27. a Horse bridled. It signifies a man in bondage and servitude.
excerpts.degree-symbol:118: In the 28. degree of ♋, ascends two men fitting under a tree, and seeing a Hawke in the tree. It denotes an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:119: In the 29. a man hanging on the Gallowes. It signifies a Theefe.
excerpts.degree-symbol:120: In the 30. degree of ♋, a Ship Sailing on the water. It denotes a Saylour or Marriner.
excerpts.degree-symbol:121: In the 1. degree of Leo, there ascends a man holding a Lyons head in his hand. It signifies a valiant man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:122: In the 2. degree, ascends a Ship, one side thereof inclining towards the waters. The man will be unfortunate in the water, that is signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:123: In the 3. degree, a man ascends sitting mourning upon a foot-stool. It signifies a sorrowfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:124: In the 4. degree, a Fish swimming in the water. A prudent and a crafty person is hereby signified, affected of great men.
excerpts.degree-symbol:125: In the 5. a Serpent lying wreathed on the ground. It signifies an envious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:126: In the 6. a man holding a sword drawn in his right hand. A litigious person desirous to resist others is signified by this degree.
excerpts.degree-symbol:127: Iu the 7. degree ariseth a man riding upon a Lyon. A valiant man, strong and wise is by this ascention denoted.
excerpts.degree-symbol:128: In the 8. a fire flaming. It imports a labourer with fire.
excerpts.degree-symbol:129: In the 9 a man well clothed and adorned. It signifies a proud man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:130: In the 10. death standing with a Syth in his hands. It signifies a murtherer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:131: In the 11. degree of ♌ ascends a woman standing and shewing her naked belly. It demonstrates an impudent immodest person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:132: In the 12. A beautifull woman ascends well adorned. It signifies a chast modest person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:133: In the 13. a Bull feeding in pasture. It signifies a man constant and stable in his deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:134: In the 14. a man standing idle ariseth. It signifies a loyterer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:135: In the 15. degree a Dog or Lyon lying couched in the grasse. A valiant man is hereby represented.
excerpts.degree-symbol:136: In the 16. a bridled Asse. An illiterate dull person it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:137: In the 17. ascends a Cammel standing. The person hereby signified will be valiant and full of Spirit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:138: In the 18. a Key of a Chamber. A man of power it imports.
excerpts.degree-symbol:139: In the 19. a man leading a horse by the bridle, It signifies a clyent or one pertaining to a noble man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:140: In the 20. a man holding role of paper in hishand. A Messenger or Carryer it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:141: In the 21. a man holding a. Key in his hand. It signifies a keeper of good hospitality.
excerpts.degree-symbol:142: In the 22. a man lying as if he were dead. It signifies a weak feeble person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:143: In the 23. degree of ♌ ascends a man having two heads. It signifies a man of severall mindes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:144: In the 24. a man holding a lock in his' right-hand. It signifies a man meditating wisdom.
excerpts.degree-symbol:145: In the 25. a man swimming in the water. It denotes a fisherman.
excerpts.degree-symbol:146: In the 26. a man working with a dungforke. It signifies a labourer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:147: In the 27. a man holding a sicle in his right hand. A laborious person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:148: In the 28. three men sporting together. It represents an idle fellow.
excerpts.degree-symbol:149: In the 29. a man and woman holding one another by the hands. An Amiable person is hereby signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:150: In the 30. degree of ♌ ascends a servant riding on a horse. The man by this ascention signified will be a servant unto others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:151: In the 1. degree of ♍, ascends a woman adorned expecting the sight of a man. It signifies a lover, either man or woman.
excerpts.degree-symbol:152: In the 2. degree ascends two women standing idle. It signifies a vagabond and idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:153: In the 3. a man holding a booke of accounts in his hand. It signifies a Merchant.
excerpts.degree-symbol:154: In the 4. a man at plow with Oxen. A labourer in the field is hereby denoted.
excerpts.degree-symbol:155: In the 5. an Eagle resting. A Merchant, but one living without labour, is hereby demonstrated.
excerpts.degree-symbol:156: In the 6. a Woman well clothed standing idle. An idle fellow it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:157: In the 7. a simple woman standing idle. It signifies a sluggish person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:158: In the 8. a man sitting under a tree. It denotes a Shepheard.
excerpts.degree-symbol:159: In the 9. degree of ♍, ascends a woman well clothed, with a red face standing idle. The man hereby signified will be angry and luxurious.
excerpts.degree-symbol:160: In the 10, a man well c • othed standing idle holding an apple in his hand. It intimates a vagabond or wanderer-about.
excerpts.degree-symbol:161: In the 11. a white horse bridled running. The man hereby signified will be swift a fo •• .
excerpts.degree-symbol:162: In the 12. a man in red clothes, with a black face. 〈◊〉 wicked person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:163: In the 2. degree, ascend two women gathering roses. A merry jocund man it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:164: In the 14. an Oxe standing in pasture. The man borne under this degree will be laborious.
excerpts.degree-symbol:165: In the 15. two merry women standing together. It signifies a merry person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:166: In the 16. ascends two Dogs running. together. The man having this degree ascending, will be a Huntsman.
excerpts.degree-symbol:167: In the 17. A faire Castle compassed about with a Hedge. It signifies a man living in safety.
excerpts.degree-symbol:168: In the 18. degree, ariseth a tree full of leaves standing in Grasse. It signifies, the man will be a labourer in woods:
excerpts.degree-symbol:169: In the 19. a man sitting as a servant upon a Horse. The man will be a reteyner to another.
excerpts.degree-symbol:170: In the 20. degree of ♍, ariseth a Bird following a Mole or a Mouse. It signifies a man contrary to others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:171: In the 21. a man ariseth standing and holding Gold in his right hand, and silver in his left. A rich man it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:172: In the 22. a naked woman carrying a Goat and a Lamb on her shoulders. An impudent immodest person it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:173: In the 23. A man ascends rowing a boat in the water with an Oare. It signifies a Marriner.
excerpts.degree-symbol:174: In the 24. A Bird bound by the neck to a post. It signifies a man who will be restrayned and held to labour.
excerpts.degree-symbol:175: In the 25. a man casting a stone into a ditch. It signifies a litigious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:176: In the 26. two men discoursing together. It signifies the man will be well educated.
excerpts.degree-symbol:177: In the 27. two women standing idle. An idle person is denoted.
excerpts.degree-symbol:178: In the 28. degree ascends some on the ground, others flying in the Aire. It signifies the man shall have much Rents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:179: In the 29. ascends dew or raine falling on the ground. The person will be religious that is signified by it.
excerpts.degree-symbol:180: In the 30. degree, ascends a dumb man standing still. It signifies a foole.
excerpts.degree-symbol:181: In the 1. degree of ♎, ascendeth a man holding in each hand a speare. The man who hath this ascendent will be a Warriour.
excerpts.degree-symbol:182: In the 2. degree a Clergy man with a pot of incense. It signifies a religious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:183: In the 3. degree a decrepit man crooked in his hands and feet. It signifies amiserable laborious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:184: In the 4. a man at plow with horses. It Signifies a labourer in the fields.
excerpts.degree-symbol:185: In the 5. a black-bird, with red bill & feet. It denotes a fat grosse man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:186: In the 6. a man drawing a plow himself. It signifies a man taking a great deale of paines without sence or reason.
excerpts.degree-symbol:187: In the 7. degree of ♎, a man holding a Gold Ring in his right hand. The person is signified to be a lover.
excerpts.degree-symbol:188: In the 8. a woman weeping over one that is sick. It represents a sorrowfull man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:189: In the 9. a man holding a sword over this head in his right hand. It signifies a litigious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:190: In the 10. a black-bird holding his beak to the ground. The man is signified to be altogether a sloven.
excerpts.degree-symbol:191: In the 11. degree a man with black hands and face, but white feet. It denotes an idle, dull; but unstable person
excerpts.degree-symbol:192: In the 12. a woman standing looking about her. The man having this ascendant will be a vagabond and idle.
excerpts.degree-symbol:193: In the 13. degree a man and a woman going two severall wayes. The man having this degree rising, wil be contentious, & live divided from others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:194: In the 14. a great looking glasse fixed upon a wall. It denotes a proud person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:195: In the 15. two hearts hanging together. It signifies a wordling.
excerpts.degree-symbol:196: In the 16. camell running: It signifies the man will be swift and valiant.
excerpts.degree-symbol:197: In the 17. a bird sweetly singing. It signifies a person full of mirth.
excerpts.degree-symbol:198: In the 18. degree of Libra, ascends the similitude of a Village neatly built. It signifies a man having dominion in the Country.
excerpts.degree-symbol:199: In the 19. degree a faire Castle on a Mountayne. It denotes a noble man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:200: In the 20. degree, a faire Altar beautifully Adorned. It signifies, a religious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:201: In the 21. degree, a man riding on an Asse or Horse. The man will be a Horseman, a groome and servant, who hath this degree rising.
excerpts.degree-symbol:202: In the 22. degree, ascends 2. horses sadled. It signifies a man coveting much and enjoying little.
excerpts.degree-symbol:203: In the 23. degree, a physitian viewing an Urinal through a glasse. The man will be a physitian, who is signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:204: In the 24. degree, ascends a man in the upper part, and a horse in the lower parts beating a Dragon with a Staffe. It signifies a strong man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:205: In the 25. degree, a Peacock standing in the Grasse. It imports a proud person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:206: In the 26. degree, ascends a man beating a Lyon with a staffe. It signifies, he will be a Conquerer in Warre.
excerpts.degree-symbol:207: In the 27. degree a shady tree standing in a garden. It signifies the man to be a gardiner.
excerpts.degree-symbol:208: In the 28. degree ascends a man labouring with a spade. A laborious person, it represents,
excerpts.degree-symbol:209: In the 29. degree, a woman standing idle. It signifies an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:210: In the 30. degree of Libra, ascends a Hare running out of a wood. The man hereby signified will be inconstant and unstable.
excerpts.degree-symbol:211: In the 1. degree of ♏, appeareth a man holding a speare in his hand. It signifies a theefe and a wicked fellow.
excerpts.degree-symbol:212: In the 2. ascends a man riding upon an Elephant. It denotes a strong valiant and stable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:213: In the 3. a man standing idle. It declares the person to be wicked and idle.
excerpts.degree-symbol:214: In the 4. a man playing on a Harpe. It denotes a jocond merry man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:215: In the 5. degree, a man ascends, wanting the lower part of his body. The man will be imperfect in his deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:216: In the 6. degree an Asse or Horse bridled and sadled. It Signifies a man producing few things to good effect.
excerpts.degree-symbol:217: In the 7. degree ascends a man sitting and having a purse of money in his right hand, and in his left hand a golden cup,. It denotes a rich marchant.
excerpts.degree-symbol:218: In the 8. a great Cock standing. The man will be a Scrivener.
excerpts.degree-symbol:219: In the 9. a man sitting in a Tub. It denotes one of litle wit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:220: In the 10. degree, ascends a head with a face much wrinkled. It Signifies a man of strange opinions.
excerpts.degree-symbol:221: In the 11. degree a man holding a Scorpion by the neck. It Signifies an envious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:222: In the 12. Degree of ♍ ariseth a great Serpent with three Flyes biting of her. It Signifies a wise man, but wicked.
excerpts.degree-symbol:223: In the 13. Degree. a fair and strong Tower. The man will be a strong labourer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:224: In the 14. Degree, a well without water. It Signifies a man instable without wit.
excerpts.degree-symbol:225: In the 15. Degree, a fair woman standing idle. It denotes an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:226: In the 16. degree a woman giving Almes to a poor man. It Signifies a mercifull man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:227: In 17. degree, a wolfe running in a field. It denotes a Robber.
excerpts.degree-symbol:228: In the 18. a house, and woman hiding her self behind the door. It signifies a sluggish idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:229: In the 19. a dog with great mouth and eares. It represents a Noble man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:230: It the 20. a man sitting on a Camel. It Signifies a valiant man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:231: In the 21. degree ascends a horse standing freely in a field. It Signifies the man shall not be subject to the yoak of others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:232: In the 22. Degree a great floud of water. An instable person is thereby denoted.
excerpts.degree-symbol:233: In the 23. Degree, many rivers flowing out of a fountaine. It Signifies an unstable unconstant person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:234: In the 24. Deg. of ♏ ascends a woman holding a distaff in her right hand. It denotes a laborious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:235: In the 25. a wolf Carrying a foul in his mouth. It Signifies a theef and a robber.
excerpts.degree-symbol:236: In the 26. Deg. a man carrying garments spoyled on his shoulders. It Signifies a destroyer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:237: In the 27. arise two men standing speaking together. It Signifies a Jocound sociable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:238: In the 28. deg. a house or great Church ascends. It Signifies a man much given to prayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:239: In the 29. deg. a Master sitting with a Book open. It Signifies a studious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:240: In the 30. Degree, ascends a Serpent with a great head. A prudent person is thereby Signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:241: In the first Degree of ♓, ascend three men standing without heads. The man hereby Signified will be religious and just.
excerpts.degree-symbol:242: In the Second Degree a man ascends shooting an arrow out of a Crosse-Bow. It Signifies a person alwayes litigious.
excerpts.degree-symbol:243: In the 3. a man sitting on a Ram, cleathed with flame. It Signifies a litigious troublesome person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:244: In the 4. a man carrying a speare on his shoulder. It Signifies a destroyer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:245: In the 5. ascends a woman carrying a Cradle on her shoulder. It denotes a laborious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:246: In the 5. an ox with three horns. It Signifies a man of good understanding.
excerpts.degree-symbol:247: In the 7. degree a woman standing Idle. The man hereby Signified will be an Idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:248: In the 8. Degree, two men playing at Dice upon a table. It Signifies a player.
excerpts.degree-symbol:249: In the 9. Degree, a great fire of wood burning. It denotes the man will be a labourer with fire.
excerpts.degree-symbol:250: In the 10. ascends a portion of gold and silver in the earth. It Signifies a rich man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:251: In the 11. Degree, an ape sitting upon a Wolfe. It Signifies a ruler over another man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:252: In the 12. a man riding upon a goat. It siignifies A contrarier of others.
excerpts.degree-symbol:253: In 13. Degree, ascends a man having his hands bound behind him. It Signifies a conquered vanquisht man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:254: In the 14. a master holding a Book open. The man hereby Signified will be learned.
excerpts.degree-symbol:255: In the 15. Degree, a man walking by a horse sadled. It Signif • es a fearfull Coward.
excerpts.degree-symbol:256: In the 16. Degree, ascend Chariot-wheels without the body. It Signifies a man void of reason.
excerpts.degree-symbol:257: In the 17. Degree, a decrepit person leaning on a staffe. It Signifies a man much given to prayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:258: In the 18. Degree, a man holding a bird by the tayl, and in the other hand a burning torch. It Signifies the man will be a fowler.
excerpts.degree-symbol:259: It the 19. Degree, ascends a house Compassed about with burning faggots. The man thereby Signified will be laborious and compassed about with fear.
excerpts.degree-symbol:260: In the 20. Degree, three men walking leading one another by the armes. It Signifies one merry and sociable.
excerpts.degree-symbol:261: In the 21. Degree a man standing in the habit of a Doctor. It denotes a wise man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:262: In the 22. degree two men piercing one another with their swords. It Signifies a theefe and manslayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:263: In the 23. degree a woman cutting another in the Breast with a knife. It signifies a manslayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:264: In the 24. degree, ascends a man running himself through with a sword. It signifies a man that will be his own enemy.
excerpts.degree-symbol:265: In the 25. degree. A man vomiting upon the ground. It signifies a Drunkard, yet a laborlous man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:266: In the 26. degree. A man playing with a little stasse. The man will be a stage player, a merry person that is hereby denoted.
excerpts.degree-symbol:267: In the 27. degree. A man hanging with his hands on a beame. It denotes a merry fellow.
excerpts.degree-symbol:268: In the 28. degree. A man riding on a Camel ascends. Hereby is signified a valiant man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:269: In the 29. degree, a man tumbling himself out of one bed into another. A Childish man it signifies,
excerpts.degree-symbol:270: In the 30. degree. A man holding a horse-shooe in his hand. It signifies a black-smith.
excerpts.degree-symbol:271: In the 1. degree of ♑, ascends two men in like forme. It signifies a jocond amiable person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:272: In the 2. degree, a man carrying a reed on his shoulder.
excerpts.degree-symbol:273: In the 3. degree a great Serpent ascends. Hereby is signified a wise man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:274: In the 4. degree, two Rakes in a field. It denotes a Clown.
excerpts.degree-symbol:275: In the 5. two gates open. It signifies a man given to hospitality.
excerpts.degree-symbol:276: In the 6. degree, a man carrying two dogs on his shoulders. It signifies a litigious person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:277: In the 7. a man standing between two women. It denotes a merry person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:278: In the 8. degree. A hand holding a Bird. A fowler it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:279: In the 9. a man falling on the ground. It denotes a feeble person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:280: In the 10. a man with a Lapwing on each hand. A Fowler or Hunter, it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:281: In the 11. degre of ♑, ascends a King Crowned receiving letters from a messenger. The man hereby signified will be an Embassador to a Prince.
excerpts.degree-symbol:282: In the 12. degree, ascends a man running swiftly. It denotes a swift person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:283: In the 13. a man carrying a goates skin on his shoulders. A hangman it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:284: In the 14. degree, a hand holding a Spear. It imports a litigious troublesome person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:285: In the 15. a man bending his knees. It denotes a noble man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:286: In the 16. degree, a man riding an unbridled horse ascends. It signifies a man without power.
excerpts.degree-symbol:287: In the 17. degree, a man with a dogs head arises. It signifies a man full of strife.
excerpts.degree-symbol:288: In the 18. degree, ascends a man divided in one halfe. It denotes a pusillanimous Childish person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:289: In the 19. degree, a man having fowr legs standing idle. It signifies a man playing or resting when he should be at work.
excerpts.degree-symbol:290: In the 20. degree, an Ape looking on himself in a glasse. It denotes a proud man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:291: In the 21. degree, a Master holding a book open. It signifies a learned man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:292: In the 22. a man digging the ground with a spade. A labourer it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:293: In the 23. a man leading a woman by the hand. A lover it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:294: In the 24. a Cooper working on a Caske, It signifies an artificer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:295: In the 25. degree of ♑, ascends a man with a Hawke on his hand. It signifies a Noble man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:296: In the 26. degree, a faire Grove of Trees. The man signified hereby will be a labourer in woods.
excerpts.degree-symbol:297: In the 27. degree. A man lying on the Grasse. A weake feeble person it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:298: In the 28. degre, a man carrying earth on his head. It denotes a rich man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:299: In the 29. degree, a fairewoman sitting on a stoole. It signifies a man full of mirth.
excerpts.degree-symbol:300: In the 30. degree of ♑, ascends the tayle of a fish. It signifies a man imperfect in his deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:301: In the 1. degree of ♒, ascends a man holding in each hand a bird. It denotes a Fowler.
excerpts.degree-symbol:302: In the 2. degree, a man holding both his hands upon his head. It signifies a sorrowfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:303: In the 3. degree. A man holding one hand upon his head. It signifies a man full of grief.
excerpts.degree-symbol:304: In the 4. a man riding on his treasure. A Merchant it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:305: In the 5. degree, a woman going before, and a man following her. It denotes a sollicitous person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:306: In the 6. degree, a man playing with a staste. It signifies a merry person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:307: In the 7. A sword drawn, lying on the ground. A Souldier or warlike person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:308: In the 8. degree, a man holding a chaine in his hand. It signifies a man not enjoying himself.
excerpts.degree-symbol:309: In the 9. degree. One man lifting up another from the ground. It denotes an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:310: In the 10. degree. a man standing without an head. It represents a man without power.
excerpts.degree-symbol:311: In the 11. degree an Armed man without an head. It signifies a Noble man without power
excerpts.degree-symbol:312: In the 12. degree of ♒, an armed man smiting down a King. The man hereby signified will be a ruler over a King. This deserves a Comment.
excerpts.degree-symbol:313: In the 13. degree, a Troop of horsmen Armed. I denotes a litigious person, and a Robber.
excerpts.degree-symbol:314: In the 14. degree. A man holding a boote in his hand. It represents a sorrowfull person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:315: In the 15. degree, two men riding on an Unicorne. It denotes a Litigious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:316: In the 16. degree of ♑, ascends a man holding fire in his hand. The man signified hereby will be a labourer with fire.
excerpts.degree-symbol:317: In the 17. deg. A woman lying sick a bed. An infirme & idle person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:318: In the 18: degree. A great Owl standing still. It denotes an envious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:319: In the 19. degree. A man holding anothers head in his hand. It denotes, a man having power and authority.
excerpts.degree-symbol:320: In the 20. deg, a decrepit woman leaning on a staffe. A weake feeble person it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:321: In the 21. degree, a man clothed lying on his back on the ground. An infirme man it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:322: In the 22. degree, a man cutting off anothers hands and feet with a hatchet. It denotes a wicked doer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:323: In the 23. degree, two dogs running together. It signifies a man given to sport.
excerpts.degree-symbol:324: In the 24. degree, a man weeping holding his hand on his head. It signifies a man alwayes sorrowfull.
excerpts.degree-symbol:325: In the 25. degree, One carrying a great Spear. A Theefe and wicked person it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:326: In 26. degree. Water flowing out of a great mountain. An instable unsetled man, it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:327: In the 27. degree. A house compassed about with a hedg. It signifies a man safe in his deeds.
excerpts.degree-symbol:328: In the 28. A man drinking out of a vessel. It declares a joyfull man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:329: In the 29. degree. A man sitting on horse-back, holding a sword drawn in his hand. It signifies a Warriour.
excerpts.degree-symbol:330: In the 30. degree. A King Crowned sitting. It signifies a man living at peace.
excerpts.degree-symbol:331: In the 1. degree of ♓, there ascends two men with one head joyned together. It signifies a troublesome and inconstant person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:332: In the 2. degree. A man sitting on the earth. It denotes a Clowne.
excerpts.degree-symbol:333: In the 3. a man eating a roll of bread. The man will be a baker signified hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:334: In the 4. an Unicorne lying on his back. A man without power it denotes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:335: In the 5. Two Maids standing together. A merry person it fignifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:336: In the 6. A great bird feeding on the ground. A covetuous miser it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:337: In the 7. degree of ♓, arises a man holding in each hand a bell. It denotes a Sexton or keeper of a Church.
excerpts.degree-symbol:338: In the 8. degree. A man sitting in a tub with a brush in his hand. It signifies a maker of bathes.
excerpts.degree-symbol:339: In the 9. degree. A Pilgrim walking. It denotes a religious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:340: In the 10. A man beating in a morter. A laborious man is hereby signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:341: In the 11. degree. A man walking with a staffe on his arme. It signifies a vagabond.
excerpts.degree-symbol:342: In the 12. degree. A young man looking behind him. Hereby is signified a timorous person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:343: In the 13. degree. A man and woman riding on horse-back. It denotes an idle person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:344: In the 14. degree. A man cutting wood in a Wood. The man will be a labourer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:345: In the 15. degree, a man ascends with a knife drawn. It denotes a man preparing himself to strife.
excerpts.degree-symbol:346: It the 16. degree, a man holding a cock in his hand. A Noble man it signifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:347: In the 17. degree, a man drowning himself in the water. It Signifies a senseless person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:348: In the 18. degree two horsmen fighting. It Signifies a troublesome Litigious man.
excerpts.degree-symbol:349: In the 19. degree, ♓ ascends a man piercing himself through with a sword. The man hereby Signified will be the cause of his own death.
excerpts.degree-symbol:350: In the 20. degree, a moon shining in the night ascends. An instable unconstant person is hereby Signified.
excerpts.degree-symbol:351: In the 21. degree, two men stabbing one another. It signifies a man-slayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:352: In the 22. degree a woman having her girments rent. It denotes an immodest person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:353: In the 23. degree, a woman swimming in a boat. It signifies an unconstant person.
excerpts.degree-symbol:354: In the 24. degree, a man and woman lying in a bed ascend. A lascivious person it represents.
excerpts.degree-symbol:355: In the 25. a man casting a stone into a ditch. A troublesome person is denoted hereby.
excerpts.degree-symbol:356: In the 26. a woman cutting off a mans head with an axe as he lyes asleep. Hereby is signified a man slayer.
excerpts.degree-symbol:357: In the 27. a man standing naked pissing. An immodest person is hereby represented.
excerpts.degree-symbol:358: In the 28. degree, a man walking by a horse holding in one hand a bird, and in the other a serpent. It denotes a man of great understanding
excerpts.degree-symbol:359: In the 29. a great fish out of the water. An unstable perion it fignifies.
excerpts.degree-symbol:360: In the 30. degree, a woman looking in a glasse. It denotes a proud unchast person.
